text:
Type: speckled wool area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, adding texture; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: wool, low textured pile
Colors: light warm beige, chestnut brown, cream speckles
Shape: rectangular, solid tone with subtle heathered speckle texture, plain edges, flat low profile, medium size
Feel: warm, calm, natural, cozy
Goes with: wood floors, charcoal or grey sofas, white walls; minimalist, Scandinavian or Japandi rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Contemporary Speckle Wool Area Rug, 5' x 7' 6", Chestnut
product.description: 100% Wool Imported Gradated tones of chestnut give this rug a beautiful texture and a calming feel. Hand-tufted of 100% wool, this contemporary rug is durable and ready to blend with your existing styles. Transitional style Hand-tufted in India of 100% wool Timeless look with durability for high-traffic areas 5' x 7'6" Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
